_comment: Copy to config.json (or set CAUTIOUSMEMORY_CONFIG to use a different path). This file only contains database and skill_dir; all other configuration such as LLM settings comes from environment variables or in-app settings, not from this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: CAUTIOUSMEMORY_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Choose one of two forms: (A) fill the individual fields below; (B) set only database.dsn to a full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): remove the database block above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Root directory for skills (each subdirectory is one skill containing SKILL.md). Priority: CAUTIOUSMEMORY_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved relative to the current working directory.
